closure_rule: Every retained technique is either a reproducible recipe, a closed measured experiment, or reference-only background. Nothing in this registry is an active AI backlog.

recipes.title: Constrained generation
recipes.target: Structured tool calls, SQL, and schema-bound outputs
recipes.failure_mode: A capable model emits invalid syntax or forbidden output shapes.
recipes.data: The target's existing frozen eval; no training data is required for the inference policy.
recipes.method_or_policy: Restrict decoding to the grammar or legal token set and score raw validity separately from task correctness.
recipes.primary_eval: Schema or grammar validity plus the target semantic metric.
recipes.resource_budget: No training; one bounded baseline/candidate evaluation.
recipes.stop_rule: Stop if validity rises but semantic correctness, safety, or latency misses its frozen gate.
recipes.decision_rule: Ship only when constrained execution passes both validity and semantic gates; otherwise retain as a diagnostic.
recipes.exercise: Run a tiny legal-token or JSON-schema fixture and compare raw versus constrained validity.
recipes.mastery_gate: Explain why legal output is not the same as correct output.

recipes.title: Specialist distillation
recipes.target: Compress a frontier or larger-model capability into a routed Mac-local specialist.
recipes.failure_mode: A small base lacks a narrow behavior that a qualified teacher can demonstrate.
recipes.data: Teacher trajectories filtered by a verifiable checker, with a sealed holdout and breadth set.
recipes.method_or_policy: Train on accepted teacher trajectories; preserve teacher identity, prompts, filtering, and student recipe.
recipes.primary_eval: Frozen target gate against stock student and frontier ceiling.
recipes.resource_budget: Fresh experiment only; budget exact teacher calls, rows, training steps, and Mac runtime before execution.
recipes.stop_rule: Stop when the target gate plateaus or breadth exceeds its allowed regression.
recipes.decision_rule: Ship as routed-only when depth wins and breadth regresses; reject when target gain is absent or negative transfer dominates.
recipes.exercise: Trace the file-ops lineage from stock 4B through distilled, multibackend, and ReST candidates.
recipes.mastery_gate: State the target gain and breadth cost that force routing.

recipes.title: Evolution strategies
recipes.target: Gradient-free optimization when rewards are evaluable but differentiation is unavailable.
recipes.failure_mode: The objective cannot provide useful gradients or the model/policy is treated as a black box.
recipes.data: A deterministic task set and scalar reward with repeated-seed variance estimates.
recipes.method_or_policy: Sample parameter or prompt perturbations, evaluate them under the same seeds, and update toward higher reward.
recipes.primary_eval: Held-out reward against the unchanged incumbent.
recipes.resource_budget: Not run in the closed project; any use is a fresh experiment with a fixed evaluation-call ceiling.
recipes.stop_rule: Stop when confidence intervals overlap the incumbent or evaluation cost exceeds the approved ceiling.
recipes.decision_rule: Reference only until a fresh target justifies its evaluation cost.
recipes.exercise: Simulate one two-parameter ES update on a deterministic toy reward.
recipes.mastery_gate: Explain the evaluation-cost tradeoff versus backpropagation.

recipes.title: GaLore and training stability
recipes.target: Reduce optimizer memory or stabilize deep training.
recipes.failure_mode: Optimizer state or unstable gradients block an otherwise valid training recipe.
recipes.data: The same tiny-overfit and held-out data used by the incumbent recipe.
recipes.method_or_policy: Change one optimizer or stability mechanism while holding model, data, seed, and eval fixed.
recipes.primary_eval: Peak memory and task/loss parity versus the incumbent.
recipes.resource_budget: Fresh experiment only; one bounded comparison before any sweep.
recipes.stop_rule: Stop if memory does not improve materially or convergence/quality regresses.
recipes.decision_rule: Adopt only with measured memory benefit and behavior parity.
recipes.exercise: Compare the recorded GaLore smoke with the gradient-checkpointing result and identify what each actually saves.
recipes.mastery_gate: Distinguish optimizer-state memory from activation memory.

recipes.title: Interpretability probes
recipes.target: Diagnose a measured model failure without treating a visualization as causal proof.
recipes.failure_mode: Aggregate scores cannot explain which layers, tokens, or representations drive a failure.
recipes.data: A frozen set of successful and failed traces from one checkpoint.
recipes.method_or_policy: Use logit lens, probes, activation patching, causal tracing, or SAE analysis with an explicit hypothesis.
recipes.primary_eval: Prediction change under a controlled intervention, not visual salience alone.
recipes.resource_budget: Closed as a learning/reference lane; future use must be attached to a specific model failure.
recipes.stop_rule: Stop if the probe has no discriminating prediction or intervention control.
recipes.decision_rule: Use findings only to change a recipe when a controlled intervention supports them.
recipes.exercise: Inspect one logit-lens or activation-patching fixture and write the causal claim it does and does not support.
recipes.mastery_gate: Separate correlation, localization, and causal intervention.

recipes.title: LoRA, DoRA, and adapter geometry
recipes.target: Adapt a frozen Mac-local base to one narrow behavior.
recipes.failure_mode: The base misses a bounded task and full fine-tuning is unnecessary or too costly.
recipes.data: Frozen train/validation/test splits with a tiny-overfit gate and breadth data.
recipes.method_or_policy: Train named target modules at a fixed rank and inspect effective-update geometry before changing capacity.
recipes.primary_eval: Target before/after score on a sealed holdout.
recipes.resource_budget: Fresh experiment only; one tiny-overfit and one bounded candidate before rank or module sweeps.
recipes.stop_rule: Stop if tiny overfit fails, the target plateaus, or required breadth regresses beyond the frozen threshold.
recipes.decision_rule: Ship, route, retry, or reject from the same frozen report card.
recipes.exercise: Run or inspect LoRA geometry for one successful and one failed adapter.
recipes.mastery_gate: Explain rank, target modules, effective rank, and why lower loss is insufficient.

recipes.title: Sparse mixture of experts
recipes.target: Increase conditional capacity while keeping active compute bounded.
recipes.failure_mode: A dense model lacks capacity and a true sparse execution path is available.
recipes.data: A deterministic routing fixture plus task data and expert-load diagnostics.
recipes.method_or_policy: Train a router and experts, then execute only selected experts with sparse gather/scatter or grouped matmul.
recipes.primary_eval: Task quality and real wall-clock/energy versus a dense parameter-matched baseline.
recipes.resource_budget: Dense-compute smoke completed; no further project run without a real sparse kernel and a fresh target.
recipes.stop_rule: Stop if all experts still execute or the router collapses.
recipes.decision_rule: Treat as capacity-only until sparse execution produces a measured compute win.
recipes.exercise: Calculate active versus total parameters for top-k expert routing and identify why dense execution saves nothing.
recipes.mastery_gate: Explain the difference between sparse parameters and sparse compute.

recipes.title: Multi-token prediction
recipes.target: Improve training signal or support speculative multi-token heads.
recipes.failure_mode: Single-token supervision or decode throughput is the measured bottleneck.
recipes.data: Sequence data with aligned future-token labels and a held-out language/task gate.
recipes.method_or_policy: Add auxiliary future-token heads with explicit loss weights and verify the base next-token head remains stable.
recipes.primary_eval: Base-task quality plus accepted speculative tokens per step.
recipes.resource_budget: Closed as reference-only; future use requires a throughput-qualified candidate.
recipes.stop_rule: Stop if auxiliary loss harms the base head or acceptance cannot offset extra work.
recipes.decision_rule: Do not adopt without an end-to-end decode win at quality parity.
recipes.exercise: Draw the label shift for two future-token heads and compute the added loss terms.
recipes.mastery_gate: Explain why training more heads does not guarantee faster decoding.

recipes.title: Optimizer and schedule selection
recipes.target: Make a correct training recipe converge stably within Mac memory and time bounds.
recipes.failure_mode: Loss spikes, under-updating, or optimizer memory blocks a frozen recipe.
recipes.data: The same tiny-overfit and held-out splits as the incumbent.
recipes.method_or_policy: Change exactly one optimizer, learning-rate schedule, or stability term per comparison.
recipes.primary_eval: Convergence, target quality, wall time, and peak memory versus incumbent.
recipes.resource_budget: Fresh experiment only; one bounded A/B before a sweep.
recipes.stop_rule: Stop if the change does not address the diagnosed bottleneck.
recipes.decision_rule: Prefer the simplest optimizer meeting stability, quality, memory, and speed gates.
recipes.exercise: Diagnose three recorded loss curves as learning-rate, capacity, or data failures.
recipes.mastery_gate: Choose an optimizer change from evidence rather than novelty.

recipes.title: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning variants
recipes.target: Trade adapter capacity, initialization, and storage for one narrow fine-tuning target.
recipes.failure_mode: Plain LoRA has a measured geometry, capacity, quantization, or many-adapter limitation.
recipes.data: One frozen target with the same split, steps, seed, and module set across variants.
recipes.method_or_policy: Compare DoRA, QLoRA, VeRA, AdaLoRA, RsLoRA, PISSA, or LoftQ one axis at a time.
recipes.primary_eval: Target score and effective update versus plain LoRA.
recipes.resource_budget: Smokes are retained; any comparative run is a fresh controlled experiment.
recipes.stop_rule: Stop when the variant does not solve the diagnosed plain-LoRA limitation.
recipes.decision_rule: Keep plain LoRA unless a variant earns a measured target or systems advantage.
recipes.exercise: Create a one-page comparison of LoRA, DoRA, QLoRA, and VeRA parameter/memory assumptions.
recipes.mastery_gate: Select a PEFT variant from the bottleneck, not from its name.

recipes.title: Precision and numerical gates
recipes.target: Reduce memory or improve throughput without invalidating model math.
recipes.failure_mode: Precision choice causes overflow, drift, excess memory, or slow execution.
recipes.data: Deterministic numeric fixtures plus one behavioral smoke.
recipes.method_or_policy: Compare reference and reduced-precision paths with explicit tolerances before measuring speed.
recipes.primary_eval: Numerical parity and behavioral parity, then memory and throughput.
recipes.resource_budget: No long loop until single-step parity passes.
recipes.stop_rule: Stop at the first unexplained numerical or behavioral failure.
recipes.decision_rule: Adopt the lowest precision that passes correctness and produces a real systems win.
recipes.exercise: Measure fp32/fp16 error on a tiny matrix operation and choose a tolerance before looking at the result.
recipes.mastery_gate: Explain why a faster kernel with wrong numerics is not an optimization.

recipes.title: Unstructured and structured pruning
recipes.target: Reduce stored or executed model structure after capability is proven.
recipes.failure_mode: Artifact size or dense topology is the measured deployment bottleneck.
recipes.data: Frozen quality and latency gates with the original checkpoint as baseline.
recipes.method_or_policy: Prune weights, heads, or layers; distinguish zeroing from physical topology removal.
recipes.primary_eval: Quality at matched artifact size and real wall-clock execution.
recipes.resource_budget: Existing smokes closed; future use requires a shipped candidate with a measured size/latency blocker.
recipes.stop_rule: Stop if sparsity does not translate into storage or execution savings.
recipes.decision_rule: Do not call zero weights a speedup without a sparse or physically smaller runtime path.
recipes.exercise: Compare 50% zero weights with physical layer removal and predict which metrics change.
recipes.mastery_gate: Distinguish statistical sparsity, compressed storage, and runtime sparsity.

recipes.title: Quantization and storage formats
recipes.target: Reduce model download, RAM, or execution cost on Mac and browser runtimes.
recipes.failure_mode: Full precision exceeds the target's distribution or memory budget.
recipes.data: Calibration samples plus frozen quality, load, and runtime gates.
recipes.method_or_policy: Apply the selected format, verify roundtrip/load parity, then measure actual kernel/runtime behavior.
recipes.primary_eval: Task quality and perplexity at measured file size, RAM, and tok/s.
recipes.resource_budget: Storage smokes are retained; large-model conversion or calibration is a fresh bounded experiment.
recipes.stop_rule: Stop if a smaller file does not load, preserve quality, or reach a matching runtime kernel.
recipes.decision_rule: Name storage-only quantization honestly; claim runtime gains only with measured kernels.
recipes.exercise: Trace one fp16-to-int4 artifact from calibration through load and decode measurement.
recipes.mastery_gate: Explain why four-bit storage can still execute with wider arithmetic.

recipes.title: Speculative heads and decoding
recipes.target: Increase local decode throughput after model quality is accepted.
recipes.failure_mode: Autoregressive decode latency is the measured user-visible bottleneck.
recipes.data: Target-domain sequences for head training plus a frozen acceptance and quality suite.
recipes.method_or_policy: Train draft heads or a draft model, verify proposed tokens with the target model, and measure accepted tokens per unit work.
recipes.resource_budget: Medusa/EAGLE smoke retained; a production recipe is a new training experiment.
recipes.stop_rule: Stop if acceptance cannot repay verification and memory overhead.
recipes.decision_rule: Adopt only on an end-to-end decode benchmark, not head acceptance alone.
recipes.exercise: Compute expected speedup from draft length, acceptance rate, and verification cost.
recipes.mastery_gate: Identify when speculative decoding becomes slower than ordinary decoding.

recipes.title: StreamingLLM and KIVI cache compression
recipes.target: Bound or compress KV memory for long local contexts.
recipes.failure_mode: KV cache growth, not model weights, is the measured memory blocker.
recipes.data: Long-context replay prompts with cached-forward quality checks.
recipes.method_or_policy: Retain attention sinks/window tokens or quantize KV groups, then replay identical continuations.
recipes.primary_eval: Cache bytes and trajectory/perplexity parity versus full KV.
recipes.resource_budget: Existing smokes are closed; new work requires a long-context product blocker.
recipes.stop_rule: Stop if memory savings lack a packed representation or quality gate.
recipes.decision_rule: Keep as an opt-in long-context lever until quality and composition gates pass.
recipes.exercise: Calculate full, windowed, int8, and int4 KV bytes for one model/context.
recipes.mastery_gate: Choose between eviction and quantization from the actual context failure mode.

recipes.title: SQL specialist lineage
recipes.target: Generate or select executable SQL on frozen schemas.
recipes.failure_mode: Small-model SQL gains fail to generalize across public and synthetic domains or emit prose wrappers.
recipes.data: Historical frozen SQL fixtures, public-style rows, five synthetic SQLite domains, and preference pairs.
recipes.method_or_policy: SFT, routing, composition, and DPO were compared under their recorded gates; remaining proposals are closed rather than queued.
recipes.primary_eval: SQLite execution plus exact and slice metrics.
recipes.resource_budget: Historical lineage closed; no additional compute is authorized by this registry.
recipes.stop_rule: The lineage stopped when stronger DPO pressure still could not change the output-format prior and no new target was frozen.
recipes.decision_rule: Retain the routed SQL candidate and failed attempts as learning evidence; start future SQL work from a fresh question.
recipes.exercise: Reconstruct the SQL lineage and mark which variable changed at each step.
recipes.mastery_gate: Explain why routing beat blending and why DPO failed to remove the wrapper.

recipes.title: Needle 2 tool-selection evaluation
recipes.target: Evaluate a tiny tool-selection artifact for Pace and local actions.
recipes.failure_mode: A tiny classifier may be fast but inaccurate or unsafe across mixed tool catalogs.
recipes.data: Ninety-four public fixtures with Pace, local-action, ambiguity, OOS, and destructive slices.
recipes.method_or_policy: Compare the full catalog with oracle-selected task catalogs; never execute predicted calls.
recipes.primary_eval: Exact tool selection and unsafe false-action rate.
recipes.resource_budget: Completed bounded CPU evaluation; no remaining run.
recipes.stop_rule: Reject when no confidence threshold offers useful safe coverage or the target slice regresses.
recipes.decision_rule: Rejected for Pace; catalog restriction is recorded only as a latency result.
recipes.exercise: Plot accepted coverage versus exactness from the confidence sweep and identify the only safe point.
recipes.mastery_gate: Explain why a four-point aggregate gain did not rescue the product decision.

recipes.title: Parakeet WGSL browser ASR
recipes.target: Test whether long-form ASR can run locally in Chrome through WebGPU.
recipes.failure_mode: Browser audio ingestion may be too slow, too large, nondeterministic, or network-dependent.
recipes.data: Eight pinned LibriSpeech test-clean clips: 34.365 seconds, 82 normalized words, eight speakers/chapters, and exact audio hashes.
recipes.method_or_policy: Run the official pinned Parakeet v3 engine on real Apple WebGPU and WhisperKit large-v3 turbo through Core ML on the identical seeded clip order, then score both with one deterministic ruler.
recipes.primary_eval: Paired WER within 2 points plus median browser RTFx >=50, no repetition regression, exact proper-noun reporting, and zero warm external requests.
recipes.resource_budget: 34.365 seconds of audio, 652.7 MiB browser download, and one bounded browser/native run.
recipes.stop_rule: Stop on software GPU fallback, model/fixture drift, warm external requests, or any resource cap.
recipes.decision_rule: Reject under the frozen conjunction because median short-clip RTFx was 33.84x; preserve the 0.0% WER and 3.51x native-latency wins.
recipes.exercise: Re-score the two prediction files, identify which WhisperKit errors come from numeric normalization, and compare aggregate with median per-clip RTFx.
recipes.mastery_gate: Explain why 0.0% WER and a 3.51x paired latency win can coexist with a correct reject decision under the frozen 50x gate.
